text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn)―― In stark contrast 
to Sakura Laurel's stellar run, Narita 
Brian's slump became painfully evident.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And in the struggling Narita Brian's eyes, 
Sakura Laurel had not yet reached the 
point of being reflected as someone to 
"look up to."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after that, Narita Brian's slump 
continued. Watching her struggle so 
painfully, the people around her began to 
feel unsettled.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meanwhile, Sakura Laurel refuses to give 
up on becoming Narita Brian's light—just 
as she had always chased after that very 
same brilliance before.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She will become a hero that gives Narita 
Brian dreams to chase. With that 
determination in mind, she set her sights 
on the "Japan Cup".
